summary: Retrieve a list of artists with optional filtering and sorting
description: Returns a collection of artist entities. The endpoint supports many filter parameters (name, id, date range, etc.) and allows sorting, pagination, and optional full count. Note that the `limit` parameter is capped at 200 rows even when set to 'all', and `fullcount` can impact performance and is not available on heavy methods. The `order` parameter defaults to ascending unless the field is a popularity metric, which always forces descending.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with `format=json` and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, maximum 200. The keyword 'all' is still limited to 200 rows.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by one or more fields. Append `_asc` or `_desc` to specify direction; default is ascending except for popularity fields which enforce descending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, the response header includes `results_fullcount` (total rows without pagination). May affect performance.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more artist IDs to filter by.

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search for artists whose name contains the given query.

parameters.name: hasimage
parameters.description: Return only artists that have an image.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter by artist join date range. Format: `yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd` (both from and to are mandatory).

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request, including status, code, warnings, and result counts.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Array of artist objects matching the query.

responseFields.name: website
responseFields.description: Artist's website or social media URL.

responseFields.name: image
responseFields.description: URL to the artist's image (default width 300).

responseFields.name: shorturl
responseFields.description: Short Jamendo URL for the artist.

responseFields.name: shareurl
responseFields.description: Full shareable Jamendo URL for the artist.

notes: `order` suffixes (`_asc`, `_desc`) override the default direction; popularity fields ignore `_asc` and always sort descending.
`limit` set to 'all' still respects the hard maximum of 200 rows.
Using `fullcount=true` may degrade performance on large result sets.
`datebetween` requires both dates separated by an underscore, e.g., `2020-01-01_2020-12-31`.
